rationale.campaign_length: 38个形成国任务叠加前身任务树，实际是一场从1444延续到后期的超长战役。
rationale.colonization: 需要在远方建立据点并沿迁徙路线推进，但主要依靠征服与附庸而非传统殖民。
rationale.complexity: 前身选择、形成门槛、政府权力、巢廷、附庸、魔法和跨洲战争同时运行。
rationale.dark_story: 主旨偏共同家园和反奴役，但女王至上、强制附庸与资源抽取保留帝国阴影。
rationale.difficulty: 形成后能力极强，但任务跨度和多洲调度显著抬高完整通关难度。
rationale.diplomacy: 母系国、特殊附庸、历史友邦与巨型附庸群决定国家效率。
rationale.early_pressure: 压力取决于前身；阿娅拉伦较顺，希蒂兰雅伦的独立战争明显更难。
rationale.magic_artifice_intensity: 鹰身女妖歌声传统、阿斯玛丽尔工程、元素奇械和先驱遗物构成核心成长线。
rationale.narrative_density: 历代女王国、离散族群、迁徙追踪和最终共同体目标形成连续史诗。
rationale.tall_play: 巢廷等级、山地建筑、公共设施和专属工程要求长期建设核心省份。
rationale.trade_economy: 布勒瓦贸易中心、跨区域网络和属国经济是维持全球帝国的重要支柱。
rationale.warfare: 100省形成门槛和覆盖多洲的任务目标让持续战争成为主循环。

national_ideas.scope_note: 国家传统、七项国家理念与野心；不含可选理念组、种族/政府加成。多套候选与条件分别列示，不视为同时叠加；形成时是否接受新理念由实际事件/决议与玩家选择决定。

description.text: 哈比伦，只有真正的鹰身女妖女王统治的国度才能拥有的头衔。第一哈比伦女王国由菲兰雅本人建立，是所有自称菲兰雅的女儿们的鹰身女妖的梦想。许多鹰身女妖都宣称自己拥有这个头衔，但只有极少数称得上正统。第二女王国由舒弥尔雅伦建立，被青铜龙阿赫特亲手摧毁。第三女王国——希蒂兰雅伦族群和莉欣雅伦族群之间的联盟——坚定地阻止了阿卡勒舍斯人向我们的山丘扩张。但这第三，也是最近的女王国沦陷在贾赫和他的将军阿玛丽安的凤凰军团之下。现在，我们崛起成为了第四女王国，而且不会再有第五个了。
description.text_en: Harpylen; a title given only to the land ruled by a true Queen of all Harpies. First realized by Firanya herself, this title is the dream of all who call themselves Firanya’s children. Many have claimed the title, although few have had any degree of legitimacy. The second Queendom was established by the flock Šumiryalen, and was only felled by the bronze dragon Aakhet himself. The third - an alliance between the Hytiranyalen and Lysinyalen flocks - firmly halted Akalšesi expansion into our hills. This third and most recent queendom fell beneath the Phoenix Legions of Jaher and his general Amarien. Ours is the fourth, and there will be no fifth.

description.text: 自古以来，鹰身女妖和她们的女王国就以复杂和避免冲突的外交政策而闻名。阿娅拉伦在1449年与达塔克斯格丁姆的残余势力建立起的朝贡体系安排能在整个布勒瓦尔持续动荡不安的数百年间大致保持不变，而第四哈比伦在接受神圣先驱为布勒瓦尔公认的宗主之前，曾是贾德帝国的名义盟友，与当时的其他附庸国相比，哈比伦保留了非凡的自治权。哈比伦地处蛇脊山脉、深木、禁忌平原和布勒瓦尔的交汇处，因此谨慎处理边境紧张局势至关重要，但除此之外，哈比伦的女族长们还培养出一种制度化的威严。到十八世纪末，从安本科斯特到飞腾的小说中都出现了哈比伦外交官的身影——她们总是仪态高贵，消息灵通，操弄着复杂暧昧的棋局，而在结局时往往又能平反昭雪。
description.text_en: Since time immemorial, harpies and their queendoms have been known for complex and conflict-averse foreign policy. The tributary arrangement extracted by Ayarallen from the remnants of Dartaxâgerdim in 1449 persisted more or less unchanged for centuries, despite continual instability across Bulwar, while the fourth Harpylen, which emerged as a nominal ally of the Jadd Empire before accepting the Divine Herald as the recognised overlord of Bulwar, retained extraordinary autonomy compared to other vassal polities of the period. Harpylen’s position at a crossroad of the Serpentspine, the Deepwoods, the Forbidden Plains and Bulwar made careful management of border tensions vital, but beyond this, the matriarchs of Harpylen fostered an institutional gravitas. By the end of the eighteenth century, the figure of the Harpylen diplomat was familiar enough to appear in novels from Anbenncóst to Feiten - they were stately, immensely well-informed, playing a complex and unclear game, and by the denouement very often vindicated.

description.text: 希蒂兰雅伦和阿娅拉伦之间的竞争，有时传说可以追溯到菲兰雅的女儿们，但随着阿娅拉伦成为第四哈比伦的掌舵人，这种竞争转变成了另一种形式。对即使是阿娅拉伦也无法否认其地位和声望的希蒂兰雅伦族群来说，其最为著名的「奇物狩猎」，可以追溯到以季节性劫掠为典型特征的鹰身女妖历史时期。进行「奇物狩猎」的鹰身女妖会搜罗一切可以找到的知识或信息；获取珍贵书籍，探索技术蓝图，甚至绑架知识分子并安置在自己的巢穴中。在第四哈比伦的统治下，现代化的「奇物狩猎」被重组为一种主要是与大氏族和贾德帝国之间的学生交流和居留制度。哈比伦政府从这种交流中获益匪浅，其中最显著的就是由此传播和普及的来自德罗拉坎德和阿加特巴尔的奇械术。
description.text_en: The rivalry between Hytiranyalen and Ayarallen, sometimes fabled to stretch back to the daughters of Firanya herself, was contorted into a different shape as Ayarallen took the helm of a fourth Harpylen. Even Ayarallen could no longer deny the position and prominence of this ancient flock, famed above all for their "Odd Hunt", a practice dating back to the period of harpy history typified by seasonal raiding. A harpy on the Odd Hunt sought out any and all knowledge or information they could find; sourcing rare books, ferreting out technological blueprints or even kidnapping intellectuals for installation in their roosts. Under the fourth Harpylen, this practice took its recognisable modern form, a highly organised system of student exchanges and residencies predominantly conducted with the Overclan and the Jadd Empire. The Harpylen government benefited greatly from this exchange, most notably through the spread and popularisation of artificery from Drolakand and Aqatbar.

description.text: 所有鹰身女妖都向哈比伦女王下跪，这是事实。即使是那些遥远的部落也承认女王的地位，哈比伦的头衔正是如此尊贵。伊什塔拉二世·阿娅拉托率先实现了哈比伦的中央集权，她承诺给予其他族群自治权和特权，以换取她们对国家各种地方行政和制度改革的支持。当然，因为族群女族长的去世往往会触发地方政府机构的传统，令其即时解散，从而造成日常管理的巨大混乱，她所给予的承诺不得不在必要时被撤销。免税和半自治贸易津贴，以及在哈比伦国家等级制度中授予的声望高但权力适度的职位，足以说服大多数族群允许阿娅拉托管理者进入自己的领土与地方政府。就这样，哈比伦从一个依赖领袖，一有挑战或女王去世就可能解体的鹰身女妖帝国，发展成为一个能够经受并适应不断变化的政治和经济环境的现代国家。
description.text_en: All harpies kneel to the Queen of Harpylen, this much is fact. Even those from far distant flocks recognize the position of the Queen, her title holds so much gravitas. The centralization of Harpylen was spearheaded by Ištara II Ayarato, promising autonomy and privileges to the other flocks in return for their support for various local administrative and institutional reforms within their lands. Of course, these concessions could be revoked if needed, and often were when the death of Matriarchs triggered the traditional instant dissolution of local government institutions, causing massive chaos for day to day administration. Tax exemptions and semi-autonomous trade allowances, as well as awarding prestigious, yet reasonable positions in the state hierarchy of Harpylen, were enough to convince most to allow the Ayarato administrators access to their lands and regional governments. With this, Harpylen evolved from a figure-driven empire of Harpies that would disintegrate at the first sign of challenge or death of a major Queen, to a modern state able to withstand and evolve with an ever-changing political and economic landscape.

description.text: 我们的山丘位于进出半人马平原许多重要贸易路线的十字路口，是平原与南部坎诺和仙灵森林之间的最后一站。因此，我们能够以极高的效率利用我们在这些路线上的位置。其中一些贸易路线甚至自古以来便已存在，而我们与这些土地上的人民的联系也是如此。我们的土地上充斥着世界各个角落的钱币，大量财富飞翔于我们的巢穴和市场之中。
description.text_en: Our hills lie at a crossroads of many important trade routes in and out of the Centaur Plains. We are the final stop between the Plains and both Southern Cannor and the Fey Woods, and we are able to exploit our position along these routes with extreme efficiency. Some of these trade routes are truly ancient, and our connection with the peoples of these lands has been tied into our existence since time immemorial. Our lands are filled with the coin of all corners of the world, and a great many riches have flown through our roosts and markets.

name.text_en: Trade with the Plain and the Forest

description.text: 虽然哈比伦国在承认神圣先驱对布勒瓦尔的主权后将贾德教作为官方宗教，但女王国的国民在文化和宗教习俗方面都保持着无与伦比、前所未有的自由。从菲兰雅湖的鹰身女妖——狩猎教的顽固追随者，到希蒂兰雅伦族群——她们内部的不同信仰就像图书馆里的书籍一样五花八门，再到杰勒卡利斯和贾尔拉斯-凯勒的人类——分别是新日崇拜和旧日崇拜的追随者，都存在于没有自上而下的信仰限制的女王国领土上。哈比伦是信徒们的大都会，其中甚至存在来自平原的亦儿歹斡思信徒、来自森林的仙灵崇拜者、以及来自坎诺和布勒瓦尔各个角落的精灵和半精灵。到了十八世纪，哈比伦的宗教信仰异常多样化，成为了逃离其他地方迫害的宗教少数派的避难所，其中最著名的是太阳崇拜者、坎诺泛神论者，甚至还有仍然信仰祖先的精灵。
description.text_en: While the Harpylen state adopted the Jadd as its official religion upon its recognition of the sovereignty of the Divine-Herald over Bulwar, those within the Queendom maintained unparalleled and unprecedented freedoms in both cultural and religious practices. From the harpies of Lake Firanya, holdout followers of The Hunt and it’s practices, to Hytiranyalen, who practiced a kaleidoscope of different faiths as diverse as the books within their libraries, to the humans of Gelkalis and Garlas-Kel, followers of the New and Old Cults respectively, there was no real top-down enforcement of faith within the lands of the Queen. Harpyleni roosts were a metropolis of peoples: followers of Irdaeos from the plains, Fey cultists from the woods, elves and Half-elves from all corners of Cannor and Bulwar. By the eighteenth century, the roosts of Harpylen were extraordinarily religiously diverse and a popular haven for religious minorities fleeing persecution elsewhere - most notably Sun Cultists, Cannorian Pantheists and even elves still following the Forebears.

description.text: 哈比伦无疑从与禁忌平原、坎诺和仙灵森林之间丰富的贸易中获利，但鹰身女妖山自身也并不缺乏财富，它拥有十分丰富的矿产资源。虽然哈比伦在木材和可用于农业的田地方面较为匮乏，但它能够开采大量的金属矿脉，其中蕴藏的资源对奇械术与工业发展至关重要。铁、铜、锡、锌、铝等金属从遍布乡野的无数矿坑中源源不断地涌出。相较于曾经彼此隔绝、因而无法真正开发鹰身女妖山矿产的女族长政权，第四哈比伦女王国则毫不受其困扰。丰富的矿藏储备，辅以鹰身女妖坚实的基建与运输网络，共同构成了十七至十八世纪哈比伦经济的支柱，使得王国有充足资金从大氏族与贾德帝国大规模地进口缺少的粮食与木材。
description.text_en: While Harpylen undoubtedly profited from the rich trade between the Plains and their trade partners in Cannor and the Fey Woods, the Harpy Hills were not without riches to call their own, boasting vast mineral wealth. While Harpylen remained poor in lumber and in fields with which to practice agriculture, it was able to tap enormous veins of metal which either remained or became vital to artificery and industrial development. Iron, Copper, Tin, Zinc, Aluminium and more all flowed from innumerable mines dotting the countryside. In comparison with the older Matriarchies, which were disconnected and thus unable to truly exploit the Hills’ mineral wealth, the fourth Harpylen had no such issue. Rich reserves, combined with robust Harpy infrastructure and transport, formed the backbone of the Harpyleni economy in the 17th and 18th centuries, allowing Harpylen to import grain and lumber in enormous quantities from the Overclan and the Jadd Empire.

description.text:
第一个出现在布勒瓦尔的鹰身女妖国家是在灰元前1159年由第一个鹰身女妖女王菲兰雅建立的。它很快成为布勒瓦尔的主导力量之一，控制了布勒瓦尔北部的大部分地区，并使南部的许多人类城邦成为朝贡国。然而，随着第一任鹰身女妖女王菲兰雅的去世，她那些争吵不休的女儿们将曾经统一的女王国分裂成了众多内斗不休的小族群。

从那时起，许多鹰身女妖试图重建曾经伟大的哈比伦女王国，而正是阿娅拉的族群将鹰身女妖一统，以终结现已衰弱的比尔萨坦舍斯王国。只有在菲兰雅的真正继承人的领导下统一起来，鹰身女妖诸部才能够携手共进，再次主宰鹰身女妖山。
description.text_en:
The first harpy state to appear in Bulwar was established all the way back in 1159 BA by the first Harpy Queen, Firanya. It quickly became one of the dominant forces in Bulwar, controlling much of Northern Bulwar and establishing tributaries on many human city-states in the south. However, with the death of the first Harpy Queen Firanya, her bickering daughters established their own flocks, splitting the once unified Queendom into petty squabbling.

Since then, many have tried to reestablish the once great realm but it was the flock of Ayara that has unified us for the final time against the now weakened Kingdom of Birzartanšes. Only as we unified under the true heir of Firanya could the flocks work together and establish dominance over the Harpy Hills once again.

description.text:
由于族群的分裂性质，宣称女王国的众多鹰身女妖创造出了不同的文化。1342年，米什恰重新统一了各部，她邀请麾下的女族长们成为她建立起的新秩序中的顾问、外交官和将军，以安抚她的新臣民，并利用每个族群的力量来发挥出最大的优势。

由此，女族长议会成立了，这是一个由最聪明和最强大的鹰身女妖组成的会议，她们将被委托管理新收复的土地。
description.text_en:
Due to the fractured nature of the flocks, separate cultures arose among the harpies who tried to claim the Queendom. As Mišqa reunited the flocks in 1342, she invited the Matriarchs to become advisors, diplomats and generals in her new order to both appease her new subjects and to use each flock’s strength to their best advantage.

With this, the Council of Matriarchs was established, a congregation of the wisest and strongest harpies who would be entrusted in the administration of the newly reclaimed lands.

description.text:
伊什塔拉俯冲是阿娅拉伦使用的一种特殊战术，利用鹰身女妖山丘陵的悬崖和山谷向下面的敌人俯冲，粉碎阵型，击溃士气。阿娅拉伦在与瓦拉姆哈尔的冲突中首次使用了这一战术，她们佯退到附近的山谷中，引诱追击的急切士兵进入狭窄的山道。

人类军队一到达山谷的尽头，鹰身女妖援军就从峡谷的壁架上出现，利爪在前俯冲下来，屠杀了众多敌军士兵。这场一边倒的战斗使许多未来的征服者不敢在毫无准备的情况下穿越鹰身女妖山，因为人们永远不知道何时会受到来自各方面的攻击。
description.text_en:
The Ištara Swoop is a special technique used by the Ayaralleni to utilise the cliffs and valleys of the Harpy Hills to descend on their enemies below, shattering formations and crushing morale. It was first utilised by Ayarallen during their clash with the state of Varamhar, where they issued a false retreat into a nearby valley to lure the pursuing eager soldiers into a narrow point.

Once the human army was at the end of the valley, harpy reinforcements appeared from atop the ledges of the canyon and swooped down with talons at the front, slaughtering many of the soldiers there. This one-sided battle deterred many future conquerors from travelling through the Harpy Hills unprepared, as one never knows when they'll be attacked from all fronts.

description.text:
虽然太阳精灵最初被视为布勒瓦尔人的救星，但事实证明，太阳精灵统治下的生活和布勒瓦尔人所渴望的自由是不一样的，布勒瓦尔人从最初被视为英雄的精灵那里得到的只有诸多的枷锁。与此相比，鹰身女妖的行政管理则秉持一个非常松散的理念，几乎不会影响到布勒瓦尔人的生活。鹰身女妖不会征收大量的税收，也不会设置苛难人民的总督。

相反，她们更倾向于与人类建立起伙伴关系，达成交易的村庄可以有自己选择的领导人、生意和习俗，还可以自由地继续信奉他们的宗教。
description.text_en:
While first seen as saviours to the Bulwari people, living under sun elf rule proved to be unlike the freedom the Bulwari people yearned for, and multiple restrictions were set in place from the people first seen as heroes. The Harpy method of governance, meanwhile, was a very loose concept and hardly impacted the Bulwari. Harpies did not impose significant taxes nor did they install governors.

Instead they preferred taking some of the men for mates and leaving those exchange villages as functionally independent with their own elected leaders, businesses and customs. These villages were free to continue practising their religion of choice.

description.text:
长期以来，鹰身女妖一直被污名化，被精灵和人类视为野蛮的掠夺者。虽然这其中可能有一丝道理，但我们不能再容忍这种名声了。我们将努力纠正我们曾经的积怨，并以新的姿态展示我们的新女王国。

受过谈判艺术训练的鹰身女妖使者，身着最好的丝绸，以最有魅力的外交官的身份出席各个宫廷，让旁人眼花缭乱。假以时日，我们的使者将到达世界的每一个角落，为我们的女王国赢获更多应得的尊重。
description.text_en:
Long have harpies been stigmatised and reduced to being seen as barbaric man-snatchers by both elves and humans. While there may have been a grain of truth in this, we cannot tolerate this reputation any longer. We shall strive to correct our previous grievances and present our new Queendom in a new light.

Harpy emissaries trained in the arts of negotiation and clothed in the finest silks shall be sent to dazzle the various courts with the presence of the most charming diplomats. In time, our emissaries shall reach every corner of the world and bring the greater the respect our Queendom deserves.

description.text:
在杰勒卡织工的启发下，许多鹰身女妖发展出一种独特的艺术形式，即羽毛挂毯。熟练的工匠们将来自布勒瓦尔北部的珍稀鸟类和鹰身女妖的鲜艳多彩的羽毛一丝不苟地编织在一起，创造出复杂的挂毯，描绘出神话故事、历史事件和日常生活的场景。这些挂毯常常被用来教育年轻的鹰身女妖，并给外国政要留下深刻印象，它们提供了对菲兰雅遗产的触觉体验。

这些羽毛挂毯最终将成为哈比伦的文化支柱，并作为一种保护各族群文化遗产的方式，描绘她们在进一步融入哈比伦社会的过程中，随着精灵和人类思想的混合而形成的独特文化。
description.text_en:
Inspired by the Gelkar weavers, many harpies have developed a unique form of art called feather tapestries. Skilled artisans meticulously weave together vibrant and colourful feathers of both rare birds from northern Bulwar and harpies to create intricate tapestries that depict mythological stories, historical events, and scenes from everyday life. Often used to educate young harpies and impress foreign dignitaries, they offered a tactile experience of Firanya’s legacy.

These feather tapestries would eventually become a cultural pillar of Harpylen and serve as a way to preserve the cultural heritage of each flock individually, depicting their unique cultures they had developed along with the mixes of elven and human ideas as they further got integrated in Harpyleni society.

description.text:
在鹰身女妖山最高峰的传统栖巢长期以来一直是阿娅拉托族群的中心，老鹰身女妖在这里定居，小鹰身女妖在这里首次飞行。现在，随着我们王室的扩张和财富的增长，新的巢穴可能会加入旧的巢穴。

每一个地方都有由我们的鹰身女妖和她们的伙伴建造的更大的建筑。每座山顶都有可能成为定居点，随着我们伟大的文明发展到新的高度，宏伟的市场和住宅都会向天空延伸。
description.text_en:
Our traditional roosts on the highest peaks of the Harpy Hills have long been the centres of our flock’s populations, where the old have settled and where the young took their first flights. Now, as our queendom expands and riches grow, new roosts may join the old.

Each one with grander constructions built by both our harpies and their mates. Atop every mountain harbours the potential for its own settlement, with grand markets and dwellings reaching towards the sky as our great civilisation grows to new heights.

description.text:
根据歌谣，南莎伦的第一位女族长是「先知」南莎，她是菲兰雅和格鲁姆-希尔哈鲁的女儿，格鲁姆-希尔哈鲁是一位强大的法师，也是佩沙吉祖人的统治者；而佩沙吉祖人是杰勒卡人的祖先。南莎有浅蓝灰色的羽毛、黑色的头发和红色的虹膜，这是大多数南莎伦女妖的共同特征，她从母亲那里继承了强大的力量，并在父亲的训练下掌握了远视和占卜术。据说她能看到山丘上发生的一切，包括过去、现在和未来。

时至今日，远视的天赋和法术在南莎伦鹰身女妖之间非常普遍，即使是那些缺乏魔法能力的鹰身女妖也不例外。
description.text_en:
According to the songs, the first matriarch of Nanšalen was Nanša the Farseer, the daughter of Firanya and Gelum-širharu, a powerful mage and ruler of the Pešakizzu; the ancestors of the Gelkar. She had light bluish gray feathers, black hair and red irises, characteristics shared by most Nanšaleni harpies, and she had inherited a great power from her mother and was trained in the arts of farseeing and soothsaying by her father. By the time she reached adulthood, she had surpassed both, and it is said that she could see everything that happened in the Hills; in the past, the present as well as in the future.

To this day, the gift and art of farseeing is common between the Nanšaleni Harpies; even between those who lack magical abilities.

description.text:
菲兰雅死后，南莎控制了东部丘陵，包括连接布勒瓦尔和禁忌平原的重要的入侵者通道。

千百年来，南莎伦鹰身女妖决定着谁能侵入布勒瓦尔，她们邀请禁忌平原的游牧民族，无论是人类还是半人马，在历史上数次入侵苏兰，挑动王国的兴衰。但战争并不是布勒瓦尔大门的唯一通行证：阿拉什八世国王和女族长宁莎拉于灰元552年远征蛇礼，建立了一条连接布勒瓦尔和湖地联邦的贸易路线。虽然这条路线在几个世纪后衰落了，但蛇礼的半人马从此一直与南莎伦保持着贸易往来，提供来自平原野兽的魔法材料和希法里姆草（一种在布勒瓦尔很受欢迎的草药，既可用于炼金术，也可作为媚药）。

对大门的控制使南莎伦的女族长们富可敌国，在山丘的部族中颇具影响力，也帮助她们抵御了时间的风沙。
description.text_en:
After Firanya’s death, Nanša took control of the eastern hills, including the important Invader’s Pass which links Bulwar with the Forbidden Plains.

For millennia, the Nanšaleni controlled who entered Bulwar, inviting the nomadic peoples of the Forbidden Plains, human and centaur alike, to invade the Suran several times throughout history, causing the rise and fall of kingdoms at their whim. But war was not the only thing that went through the gates of Bulwar: a trade route that linked Bulwar with the Lake Federation was established after king Araš VIII and matriarch Ninšara’s expedition to the Serpent’s Gift in 552 AA. While the route declined centuries later, the centaurs of the Serpent’s Gift kept trading with Nanšalen, providing magical materials from the beasts of the plains and šilphalim, a herb popular in Bulwar utilized both in alchemy and as an aphrodisiac.

The control over the gate made the matriarchs of Nanšalen ludicrously wealthy and influential between the flocks of the hills and helped them withstand the sands of time.

description.text:
玛赫塔利，女族长的精英卫队，精锐的皇家斗士。她们的战斗如同华丽的游行，金色的鳞甲下是天蓝的束腰外衣，华丽的头盔装饰着银色的羽毛。

她们首选的武器是弓和箭，她们是布勒瓦尔最好的弓箭手。与其他鹰身女妖不同的是，她们更喜欢从地面射击，这样可以更好地利用她们使用塔拉斯克角制成的长弓，这是为数不多的能让鹰身女妖发挥全部力量的材料之一，给予了她们更大的射程和精度。

在布勒瓦尔语中，「玛赫塔利」意为「不朽」，因为人们似乎认为玛赫塔利从未在战斗中死亡过，尽管并不清楚这个说法出处为何，但作为女族长的皇家卫队，她们在阿拉什八世的统治下参与了在苏兰平原，蛇礼，以及萨拉哈德以南赫特拉塔与豺狼人王国的多场战役。
description.text_en:
The Mahdari are the royal guard of the matriarch, an elite group of warriors that march to battle as if they were parading, dressed with blue and gold tunics below the scale armor and adorning helmets covered in silver feathers.

Their weapon of choice are the bow and arrow, and they are known as some of the best archers in all of Bulwar. Contrary to other harpies, they prefer to shoot from the ground, where they can better utilize their long composed bows made with Tlalusk’s horns, one of the few materials that allow a harpy to use their full strength with a bow, which gives them more range and accuracy.

The name Mahdari is Bulwari for Immortal, since it is believed that none of the Mahdari ever died on battle, although the real origin of the word is unclear. As the royal guards of the matriarch, they participated in many battles in the Suran plain, the Serpent’s Gift and even Kheterata and the gnoll lands south of the Salahad during Araš VIII’ expeditions.

description.text:
南莎伦女妖被布勒瓦尔人昵称为「王家鹰身女妖」，这是因为她们与阿卡勒舍斯的联系，因为南莎伦的女族长也是其第一代国王阿拉什的后裔，两个家族被视为一体。自布勒瓦尔文艺复兴以来，阿卡勒舍斯的国王统治平原，南莎伦的族长统治丘陵，按照惯例，每一位新族长都要由阿卡勒舍斯的国王加冕，反过来，每一位新国王也要由南莎伦的族长加冕。

南莎伦的女族长佩戴的王冠与阿卡勒舍斯的王冠相似，由钴和银制成，并饰有来自宝石岛的蓝宝石。这是矮人的杰作，由国王阿拉什八世委托金堡的工匠锻造，作为他同父异母的妹妹宁莎拉女族长的加冕礼物。
description.text_en:
The Nanšaleni harpies are nicknamed "Royal Harpies" by the Bulwari due to their ties to Akalšes, since the matriarchs of Nanšalen also descend from Araš the First King and the two families are considered one. Ever since the Bulwari Renaissance, when the kings of Akalšes ruled over the plain and the matriarchs of Nanšalen ruled over the hills, it has been customary for every new matriarch to be crowned by the king of Akalšes and, in return, every new king is crowned by the matriarch of Nanšalen.

The matriarchs of Nanšalen wear a crown similar to the Akalšesi one, made of cobalt and silver, and decorated with sapphires from Gemisle. A work of Dwarven craftsmanship, it was commissioned by king Araš VIII to the artisans of Verkal Gulan as a crowning gift for his half-sister, Matriarch Ninšara.

description.text:
通过与平原地区的贸易，女族长宁莎拉变得富裕起来，她用自己的财富为她的族群建造了一个新的首都。瓦茵维莉娅建在哈塔屯河的源头，可以方便地通往苏兰平原和入侵者通道，成为了南莎伦雄伟的栖巢。

这座城市建在几块台地上，哈塔屯瀑布将城市一分为二。下层是集市、仓库以及人类和矮人居民的住所，而中层则是鹰身女妖的住所，只有通过飞行或通过赫霍多瓦尔工程师建造的四部巨型升降机才能到达。而上层则以花园为主，是南莎伦女族长的住所——天蓝宫殿，也是巢穴名称的由来。
description.text_en:
Wealthy due to the trade with the plains, matriarch Ninšara used her treasures to build a new capital for her flock. Built on the source of the Hatatun river, with easy access to both the Suran plain and the Invader’s Pass, Vainviria became Nanšalen’s majestic roost.

The city is built on several terraces, with the Hatatun falls splitting the city in two. The lower levels are home to bazaars, warehouses and the residences of the human and dwarven inhabitants, while the middle ones, only accessible by flying or via the four massive lifts built by the engineers of Hehodovar, contain the residences of the harpies. The upper level, on the other hand, is dominated by gardens and is home to the palace that gives the roost its name, the Sky-Blue Palace, the residence of the Matriarchs of Nanšalen.

description.text: 几个世纪前，南莎伦的族长们因为与阿卡勒舍斯的关系而皈依了太阳崇拜，并接纳了阿卡勒舍斯的太阳崇拜版本：国王崇拜。该教派认为，阿卡勒舍斯国王是苏雷尔选中来统一整个布勒瓦尔的。这一信条被称为国王的神圣职责，南莎伦鹰身女妖也认同这一信仰，并发展出了与之平行的女王的神圣职责。对于南莎伦鹰身女妖来说，他们的族长被苏雷尔选中，在她的羽翼下团结鹰身女妖，并帮助阿卡勒舍斯的统治者在苏雷尔的花园里创造和平。
description.text_en: Centuries ago, the matriarchs of Nanšalen converted to the Sun Cult due to their relation with Akalšes and adopted the version of the Cult practiced there: the Cult of Kings. This sect of the cult believed that the King of Akalšes was Chosen by Surael to unite all of Bulwar. This belief, called the divine duty of Kings, was shared by the Nanšaleni harpies, which developed a parallel called the divine duty of Queens. For the Nanšaleni, their matriarch was Chosen by Surael to unite harpykind under her wing and to help the ruler of Akalšes to create peace in Surael’s garden.

description.text:
与阿拉什之于阿卡勒舍斯一样，南莎伦鹰身女妖也认为宁莎拉注定要成就一番伟业。

宁莎拉二世与阿拉什十世出生在同一天，两人都经历了余烬时代的最后阶段和贾德教的崛起。虽然名义上她是统一了哈比伦山脉的阿娅拉伦族群的臣民，但她还是尽可能地保持自主。最后，在贾达尔-阿卡勒舍斯战争期间，她甚至不顾阿娅拉伦女族长的禁止，去帮助自己的盟友和亲戚。67岁的她在特拉兹布拉农战役中指挥玛赫塔利，在那场战役中，她被佐迦·噬暗者击败，失去了一只翅膀。

与阿拉什十世一样，她在马背上与她的亲人并肩作战，并在阿纳哈拉普蒂的最后一次冲锋中死于贾达尔的长子安德烈里昂之手。
description.text_en:
Ninšara is the name given to the daughters of the matriarch that are born in the summer solstice and, in the same vein as Araš for Akalšes, the Nanšaleni believe that a Ninšara is destined for great deeds.

Ninšara II was born on the same day as Araš X, and both lived through the final stages of the Age of Cinders; and the rise of the Jadd. While nominally a subject of the Ayara flock, who united the harpies of the Harpy Hills, she tried to do as much as possible to remain autonomous. Eventually, during the Jaddari-Akalšesi war, she even went to help their ally and kin, defying the Ayara matriarch in the process. At the age of 67 years, she commanded the Mahdari in the battle of Traz-Buranun, where she lost a wing to Zokka Devourer-of-Darkness.

Like Araš X, she died to Andrellion, Jaddar’s firstborn son, during the last charge of the Anahallapti, fighting at horseback alongside her kin.

description.text: 在因菲兰雅的死亡而分裂之后，我们的族群是第一个离开哈比伦女王国的人。我们定居在西巴哈尔，一个同时居住着矮人和人类的地区。我们既不打算走得更远，也不打算驱逐这些人，我们善于在不发生流血的情况下融入这些社区。
description.text_en: Our flock was the first to leave the first Harpy Queendom, following its fracturing on the death of Firanya. We settled in Western Bahar, a region inhabited by both Dwarves and Humans. With neither intent to go further nor evict these peoples, we became adept at integrating ourselves among these communities without bloodshed.

description.text: 奇物狩猎是我们部群最引以为豪和最重要的创新。我们不再像往常那样为了配偶和金子而突袭，而是寻求更有价值的奖品；知识。我们带着沿途发现的书籍、记述、蓝图、工艺品和智者的宝库回来，实施我们邻居的学问，给我们的土地和人民带来进步和繁荣。
description.text_en: The Odd Hunt is our flocks proudest and most important innovation. Instead of the usual raids for mates and gold, we sought a more valuable prize; knowledge. Returning with a trove of tomes, recounts, blueprints, artifacts and wise people found along the way, we implement the learnings of our neighbors to bring advancement and prosperity to our lands and people.

description.text: 长期以来，我们的部群一直与阿娅拉伦女族长保持着激烈的竞争关系，经常在天空中交手和冲突，在我们生活在这些山丘的历史中不断地进行战争。我们的优势在灰元490年的塞得菲拉奥尔之战中得到了巩固，在那里我们果断地击溃了阿娅拉伦部群，支配了战斗的天空，把她们赶出了我们的土地。
description.text_en: Our flock has long held a fierce rivalry with the Ayarallen matriarchy, frequently trading blows and clashing in the skies, constantly at war throughout our history of living in these hills. Our superiority was cemented in the battle of Šetufiraor of 490AA, where we decisively routed the Ayaralleni flock, dominating the skies of battle and driving their from our lands.

name.text: 希蒂兰雅伦-阿娅拉伦竞争

description.text: 第三哈比伦女王国形成于我们族群和莉欣雅伦族群之间的联盟，作为对抗南莎伦和她们的人类盟友阿卡勒舍斯的堡垒，后者在灰元546年向东部族群和杰勒卡城市发起进攻。我们的女族长灵巧的外交手段和对土地的承诺被证明是富有成效的，我们和杰勒卡人一起，在灰元550年的杰勒卡利斯之战中果断地击溃了阿卡勒舍斯的入侵，结束了南莎伦的扩张。
description.text_en: The third Harpy Queendom was forged by the alliance between our flock and the Lysinyalen flock, as a bulwark against Nanšalen and their human allies of Akalšes, who in 546 AA campaigned into the eastern flocks and the Gelkar cities. Our Matriarch’s deft diplomacy and promises of land proved fruitful, and together, alongside the Gelkar, we were able to rout the Akalšesi incursion decisively in the battle of Gelkalis in 550AA, bringing an end to Nanšalen's expansion.

description.text: 希蒂兰雅的土地是一个多样化的地方，居住着人类、精灵和地精。我们的意志是通过灵巧和温柔的触摸、宽松的政策和对我们王国人民之间差异的理解来执行的。这导致了我们被誉为是一个接受的灯塔。
description.text_en: The lands of Hytiranya are a diverse place, inhabited by humans, elves and goblins. Our will is enforced by a deft and gentle touch, lenient policies and understanding of the differences between the peoples of our Queendom. This has led to a reputation for being a beacon of acceptance.

name.text: 我们的翅膀之下众生平等

description.text: 我们的部群是第一个面对哈佐比内的鹰身女妖，我们是第一个经受住阿赫特之怒的鹰身女妖，我们战胜了前来屠杀我们的卡斯坦之民，更是第一个在贾赫的矛尖上流血的鹰身女妖。我们的部群经久不衰，牢不可破，无论我们面对谁，无论我们流血多少次，无论我们弯曲多少次，我们都不会崩溃。
description.text_en: Our flock was the first to face against the Xhazobine, we were the first to weather Aakhet’s wrath, we outlasted the Castanites who came to slaughter us and were the first to bleed upon Jaher's spearpoints. Our flock is enduring and unbreakable, and no matter who we face, no matter how many times we bleed, no matter how many times we bend, we shall never break.

description.text: 我们与大氏族的相邻允许我们不断获得崭新发展的知识，而奇物狩猎现在在本质上更多的成为了一种组织化的外交方式。利用魔法和科学一起创造奇迹的奇械术，对于充满好奇心的希蒂兰雅伦族群来说，确实是一笔财富，她们也能将自己的发明奇迹传播到整个哈比伦王国。
description.text_en: Our borders with the Overclan allow us access to a new and evolving knowledge in our Odd Hunts, now far more diplomatic and organized in nature. Artificery; the use of Magic and Science together to create wonders is truly a treasure for the already inquisitive minds of the Hytiranyan flock, who would spread the wonders of their inventions throughout the entire Harpylen Queendom.

player_overview.avoid_if: 如果你厌恶大范围征服、跨洲调度、复杂附庸管理，或希望形成后继续保留前身任务树，请避开。
player_overview.how_it_plays: 前期用一个鹰身女妖国家统一布勒瓦，中期形成F98并建设巢廷与附庸网，后期跨洲追踪族群、推进魔法工程并完成近半世界征服。
player_overview.overview: 哈比伦不是起始国，而是布勒瓦鹰身女妖统一故土后的全球形成国。你先完成阿娅拉伦、南莎伦或希蒂兰雅伦等前身战役，再以F98建立女王国；中期经营母系国与巢廷、发展专属政府权力和歌声魔法，后期沿古老迁徙路线跨越各洲，寻找并保护远方族群。它的理想是共同家园，实际玩法却是高强度征服与巨型附庸群。
player_overview.recommended_for: 适合喜欢长形成链、附庸群、全球收集、山地建设、魔法系统和共同家园史诗的玩家。
signature_features: 女王国权力把压制独立倾向、消除侵略扩张、强化附庸和抽取属国发展度整合成一套附庸帝国循环。
全球迁徙线要求追踪不同鹰身女妖族群，并在禁忌平原、深林、萨尔哈尔和东洲扶植特殊伙伴。
山地巢廷与阿斯玛丽尔魔法工程把建筑布局、先驱遗物和歌声法术变成长期成长系统。
player_overview.tagline: 重建第四也是最后一个鹰身女妖女王国，用巢廷、附庸和歌声魔法把散落世界的姐妹重新带回同一片天空。

reasons: 形成前后的两段任务树让国家成长感非常完整
附庸群不是装饰，而是政府权力、外交和经济的核心资源
世界迁徙线把全球扩张包装成寻找离散族群的连续故事
巢廷与歌声魔法为超大规模征服提供独特的建设和技术反馈
warnings: 领土要求接近半个世界征服，战役很长
形成后会替换普通前身任务树
抽取属国发展度可能反过来卡住需要发展省份的任务
多洲附庸和宗教文化管理的操作量很大

values.rationale: 反奴役、反剪翼、为离散鹰身女妖提供家园和公共设施，并允许非鹰身女妖保留领袖、传统和法律；强制附庸和资源抽取主要降低克制。
